description: Command reference for the network platforms most often met in the field. Commands are grouped by task so the same question can be answered on any vendor.

vendors.name: Cisco IOS and IOS-XE
vendors.description: Catalyst switches and ISR routers. Configuration is applied immediately and lost on reload unless written to startup-config.

commands.description: Model, IOS version, uptime, last reload reason.
Active configuration. Add | section interface to narrow it.
One line per interface: address, status, protocol.
Switch view: port, VLAN, duplex, speed, type.
Counters and errors for one port.
CRC, collisions and drops across all ports in one table.
What is consuming the control plane.
Serial numbers of the chassis and every module.
VLAN database and which ports are in each VLAN.
Learned MAC addresses with port and VLAN.
Locate one device on the switch.
Trunk ports, native VLAN and allowed VLAN list.
Root bridge, port roles and states for one VLAN.
Directly connected Cisco devices with their addresses.
Routing table with the source protocol of each route.
Which route would be used for one destination.
BGP peers, state and prefix counts.
Leases issued when the device is the DHCP server.
Create a VLAN and name it.

commands.command:
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/5
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
commands.description: Standard access port for an end device.

commands.command:
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/24
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30
commands.description: Trunk with an unused native VLAN and an explicit allowed list.

commands.command:
interface Vlan10
 ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
commands.description: Switched virtual interface for inter VLAN routing.
Relay DHCP broadcasts to a server, applied on the client side interface.
Make this switch the root bridge deliberately.
Persist the configuration. write memory does the same.
Test from a specific source interface.
PoE budget and per port consumption.
Cable length and fault distance. Read with show cable-diagnostics tdr.
Live debugging. Always follow with undebug all.

vendors.name: Aruba AOS-CX
vendors.description: Current Aruba switch operating system. Configuration is committed as you type and saved with write memory.

commands.description: Model, serial number, uptime, resource usage.
Status of every port in one table.
Detail and counters for one port.

commands.command:
interface 1/1/24
 no shutdown
 vlan trunk native 999
 vlan trunk allowed 10,20,30
commands.description: Trunk port with an explicit allowed list.

vendors.name: Aruba AOS-S (ProCurve)
vendors.description: Older ProCurve and Aruba 2530 or 2930 line. VLAN membership is expressed from the VLAN, not from the port.

commands.description: Create a VLAN and add access ports as untagged members.
Add a VLAN to a trunk by tagging it on the uplink port.

vendors.name: Fortinet FortiOS
vendors.description: FortiGate firewalls. The CLI complements the web interface and is where diagnostics actually happen.

commands.description: Packet capture. Verbosity 4 shows interfaces, l prints local time.

commands.command:
diagnose debug flow filter addr 10.0.0.5
diagnose debug flow show function-name enable
diagnose debug flow trace start 20
diagnose debug enable
commands.description: Trace how a packet is processed, including which policy matched and why it was dropped. The single most useful FortiGate command.

commands.command:
diagnose debug disable
diagnose debug reset

config system interface
 edit port1
 set ip 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
 set allowaccess ping https ssh
 next
end
commands.description: Address an interface and choose which management protocols it answers.

commands.command:
config router static
 edit 1
 set gateway 192.168.1.254
 set device port1
 next
end

config firewall policy
 edit 0
 set srcintf lan
 set dstintf wan1
 set srcaddr all
 set dstaddr all
 set service HTTPS
 set action accept
 set nat enable
 next
end
commands.description: Policy with source NAT. edit 0 assigns the next free identifier.
Back up the configuration before any change.

vendors.name: Ubiquiti UniFi and EdgeOS
vendors.description: UniFi devices are normally driven by the controller; the CLI is for adoption problems and diagnostics. EdgeOS uses a commit and save model.

commands.description: Model, firmware, adoption status and controller address.
Point a device at a controller. Repeat once the device appears as pending.
Detailed status including uplink and radio state.
Configuration as a flat list of set commands, easy to copy.

commands.command: set interfaces ethernet eth1 vif 10 address 10.10.10.1/24

commands.description: Apply, persist, then leave configuration mode. Commit without save is lost on reboot.

vendors.name: MikroTik RouterOS
vendors.description: Menu based CLI where every command is a path. Powerful and inexpensive, with defaults that need review before production.

commands.description: Full configuration as commands, without defaults.
Live per flow bandwidth on an interface.

vendors.name: Juniper JunOS
vendors.description: Candidate configuration model: changes are staged and only applied on commit, with commit confirmed as a safety net.

commands.description: Enter configuration mode on the candidate configuration.

commands.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/5 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members USERS
commands.description: Access port in a named VLAN.

commands.command: set interfaces irb unit 10 family inet address 10.10.10.1/24

commands.description: Difference between the candidate and the active configuration. Always run before committing.
Apply and roll back automatically in five minutes unless confirmed. Use it on remote devices.
Return to the previous committed configuration.

vendors.name: Windows networking
vendors.description: The commands run from the machine in front of you, in their modern PowerShell form with the legacy equivalent where it is still faster.

commands.description: Address, gateway and DNS per interface. Replaces ipconfig /all.

commands.command: Get-NetAdapter | Format-Table Name, Status, LinkSpeed, MacAddress

commands.description: ARP and neighbour cache. Legacy: arp -a.
Listening sockets with owning process. Legacy: netstat -ano.
TCP reachability with route and source information.
Query a specific resolver to separate client cache from server data.
Flush the resolver cache. Legacy: ipconfig /flushdns.
Traceroute with per hop loss statistics.
Generate a full wireless connectivity report.
Built in capture with no software to install. Stop with netsh trace stop.

vendors.name: Linux networking
vendors.description: Useful when the appliance you are troubleshooting is really a Linux box, which most of them are.

commands.description: Listening sockets with process. Replaces netstat.
Effective DNS configuration per link on systemd hosts.
Targeted capture. -w file.pcap to open it in Wireshark later.
Traceroute and continuous loss measurement in one report.
Follow the resolution from the root down.
Speed, duplex and link detection at the driver level.
